items.text: Fixed the undergarments button so it now responds to clicks.
You can now type at the balloon console while its door is opening, and the computer emits a humming sound.
Resolved a UI memory leak on close and prevented downed players from being unexpectedly removed from the UI.
Reduced the balloon platform size and added a dedicated signal alarm.
Large furnaces and water catchers can no longer be placed under triangle roofs; they must be placed on floor grills or elsewhere.

Dog heel, seek and fetch behaviors have been overhauled: heels are more responsive, dogs no longer lose track of distant sniff targets, can sniff sleeping bags, players and corpses, and fetch mechanics are smoother.
Free‑roam dog movement now feels natural: exaggerated leaning and spot‑turning are removed, and dogs play idle animations when stopping.
Tattoo system received major QoL fixes: missing chair colliders restored, a new artist stool added for easier tattooing, and tattoos no longer persist through a server wipe when you die.
Explosive splash damage now correctly damages open doors based on their actual colliders, fixing the previous inconsistency.
The Rust+ pairing screen now works even without push‑enabled devices and shows clear error feedback if push fails.
Item option icons now display correctly when panels are active.
Chat emoji videos stop playing when disconnected, preventing endless playback.
Raid window timer display fixed for accurate countdowns.
Fixed a DLSS issue that could hang the GPU at game start and added a preset option with safety checks.
Adjusted the balloon signal alarm’s volume and pitch for clearer detection.

Panels pie menu now plays its selection sounds correctly.
Player lookup commands now correctly require a name, preventing unintended matches.

CCTV bookmark arrows no longer cause accidental camera activation when clicking nearby.

2026-11-25.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Recoil duration reduced by 75% on most weapons, making sustained fire feel more controllable.

### Movement & Controls
- Strafing now cancels sprint, and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed.
- Boat and cargo parenting bugs fixed: players no longer unintentionally transfer to cargo ships, exclusion zones prevent attachment to moving excavator arms, and ladder climbing from boats no longer drags players off.

### Building & Structures
- Gingerbread physics material added to low and half walls, affecting building physics for gingerbread structures.

### Trading & Crate System
- Tradable skin bundles now retain their tradeable status, fixing incorrect non‑tradable markings.
- Crate generators are now correctly recognized as bundles, ensuring proper operation within the bundle system.

### Tech Tree & UI
- Tech‑tree shuffled with a new in‑editor graph editor and reorganised tier 1‑3 trees for Hardcore and Primitive modes; UI now opens up to eight times faster, cutting load time from ~1.2 s to ~0.15 s.

### Boss & NPC Physics
- Scrap King’s physics material changed to metal, altering its interactions and damage handling.

### Customization
- New console variable lets players hide all tattoos

### Lighting & Visuals
- Brightness transition at dawn and dusk is smoother
- Night light now works correctly with the anti‑gamma fix
- Added foreground and background floor geometry for night shadows to prevent gamma spikes; includes a toggle convar

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sprint mechanics have been updated to the modern movement system, changing acceleration and stamina behavior for faster, smoother running.
